knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,

required_packages <- c(
  "Biobase",
  "data.table",
  "dplyr",
  "DT",
  "e1071",
  "ggplot2",
  "jsonlite",
  "knitr",
  "limma",
  "maSigPro",
  "readxl",
  "readr",
  "scales",
  "tibble",
  "tidyr",
  "xfun"
)
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop(
    "Install required package(s): ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". maSigPro and limma are available from Bioconductor.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Biobase)
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(e1071)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(limma)
  library(maSigPro)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
})

# Mfuzz imports optional Tk components and may not load on headless/macOS
# systems without XQuartz. Use the package when available; otherwise run the
# same standardization, fuzzifier formula, and e1071 fuzzy c-means backend.
mfuzz_package_available <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(
  requireNamespace("Mfuzz", quietly = TRUE),
  error = function(error) FALSE
))

current_input <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(), error = function(e) NULL)
render_dir <- if (!is.null(current_input) && nzchar(current_input)) {
  dirname(normalizePath(current_input, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
} else {
  normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}
report_source_dir <- Sys.getenv("PDTOMSSTATS_REPORT_SOURCE_DIR", unset = "")
report_dir <- if (nzchar(report_source_dir)) {
  normalizePath(report_source_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
} else {
  render_dir
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = report_dir)

required_value <- function(value, parameter_name) {
  if (is.null(value) || length(value) != 1L || is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) {
    stop("Set the ", parameter_name, " parameter before rendering.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  value
}

resolve_path <- function(path) {
  path <- required_value(path, "file path")
  if (grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", path)) path else file.path(report_dir, path)
}

analysis_file <- normalizePath(
  resolve_path(required_value(params$analysis_file, "analysis_file")),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
protein_workbook <- NULL
if (!is.null(params$protein_workbook) &&
    length(params$protein_workbook) == 1L &&
    !is.na(params$protein_workbook) &&
    nzchar(params$protein_workbook)) {
  protein_workbook <- normalizePath(
    resolve_path(params$protein_workbook),
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  )
}
output_dir <- resolve_path(params$output_dir)
figure_dir <- resolve_path(params$figures_dir)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# A relative figure path lets Pandoc embed figures even when figures_dir was
# supplied as an absolute path.
report_figure_dir <- xfun::relative_path(
  normalizePath(figure_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
  dir = render_dir
)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.path = file.path(report_figure_dir, paste0(params$request, "-")),
  dev = c("png", "pdf")
)

set.seed(as.integer(params$random_seed))

source(
  file.path(report_dir, "R", "input-functions.R"),
  local = knitr::knit_global()
)

write_result <- function(data, filename) {
  path <- file.path(output_dir, filename)
  readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(data), path, na = "")
  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

describe_timecourse_column <- function(column) {
  source_prefix <- ""
  base_column <- column
  if (startsWith(column, "maSigPro_")) {
    source_prefix <- "maSigPro: "
    base_column <- sub("^maSigPro_", "", column)
  } else if (startsWith(column, "limmaSpline_")) {
    source_prefix <- "limma-spline: "
    base_column <- sub("^limmaSpline_", "", column)
  } else if (startsWith(column, "limma_")) {
    source_prefix <- "limma-spline: "
    base_column <- sub("^limma_", "", column)
  }

  exact <- list(
    Step = c(
      "Filtering or analysis step.",
      "Read from top to bottom to see which rule was added at each stage."
    ),
    Stage = c(
      "Filtering or analysis stage.",
      "Read from top to bottom to see how many proteins remain after each rule."
    ),
    Proteins = c(
      "Number of proteins represented by the row.",
      "Use it to compare the size of filtering stages, categories, or clusters."
    ),
    Run = c(
      "Unique sample/run identifier.",
      "Each row of a design matrix links one analyzed sample to its predictors."
    ),
    Protein = c(
      "Protein identifier inherited from the MSstats protein-level data.",
      "Use this key to join model, clustering, and source-result tables."
    ),
    GeneSymbol = c(
      "Gene symbol parsed from the GN= field in the Proteome Discoverer protein description.",
      "A slash separates symbols when the MSstats identifier contains multiple protein accessions; NA means no GN= annotation was available."
    ),
    Variable = c(
      "maSigPro model term retained by backward selection.",
      "A protein listed for a group-by-time term contributes to the differential-trajectory set."
    ),
    Group = c(
      "Model component or biological group represented by the row.",
      "Interpret it with the configured reference and comparison groups."
    ),
    GroupComponent = c(
      "maSigPro group-level component used to summarize selected proteins.",
      "Use the count to see which encoded group component received retained model assignments."
    ),
    Intercept = c(
      "Model intercept predictor.",
      "Represents the encoded reference-group baseline in the fitted design."
    ),
    OverallModelPValue = c(
      "Raw maSigPro full-model p-value versus an intercept-only model.",
      "Smaller values indicate evidence that the protein changes with group and/or time; use the adjusted value for selection."
    ),
    OverallModelAdjustedPValue = c(
      "Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted maSigPro overall-model p-value.",
      "Values at or below model_fdr pass the first maSigPro screening step."
    ),
    AdjPValue = c(
      "Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted differential-trajectory p-value.",
      "Compare it with the corresponding method's configured FDR threshold; smaller values indicate stronger evidence."
    ),
    StepwiseModelPValue = c(
      "maSigPro p-value for the model remaining after backward term selection.",
      "This summarizes the selected model; interaction selection and R-squared are also required."
    ),
    ModelRSquared = c(
      "R-squared for the retained maSigPro model.",
      "Higher values mean the selected terms explain more observed variation; values must meet min_r_squared."
    ),
    RSquared = c(
      "R-squared for the retained trajectory model.",
      "Higher values indicate that the fitted model explains more observed variation; it is not a significance probability."
    ),
    PassedOverallModelFDR = c(
      "Whether the protein passed the configured maSigPro overall-model FDR.",
      "TRUE means it passed the first maSigPro significance screen."
    ),
    PassedRSquared = c(
      "Whether the retained maSigPro model passed min_r_squared.",
      "TRUE indicates adequate configured model fit, not biological validation."
    ),
    DifferentialTimeInteraction = c(
      "Whether the method selected a group-by-time trajectory difference.",
      "TRUE means the protein enters that method's significant set and Mfuzz analysis."
    ),
    InteractionF = c(
      "limma moderated F statistic jointly testing all group-by-spline interactions.",
      "Larger values provide stronger joint evidence of different trajectories; assess significance with the adjusted p-value."
    ),
    InteractionPValue = c(
      "Raw p-value for limma's joint spline-interaction test.",
      "Smaller values indicate stronger evidence before correction for testing many proteins."
    ),
    InteractionAdjustedPValue = c(
      "Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted limma spline-interaction p-value.",
      "Values at or below limma_interaction_fdr define the limma-spline significant set."
    ),
    FullModelRSquared = c(
      "R-squared from the full limma spline design.",
      "Describes fit but is not the limma significance criterion; use the adjusted interaction p-value for selection."
    ),
    SignificantInMaSigPro = c(
      "Whether the protein passed the complete maSigPro trajectory criteria.",
      "TRUE means it is included in the maSigPro-specific Mfuzz input."
    ),
    SignificantInLimmaSpline = c(
      "Whether the protein passed the limma joint interaction FDR.",
      "TRUE means it is included in the limma-spline-specific Mfuzz input."
    ),
    SignificanceCategory = c(
      "Agreement label: Both methods, maSigPro only, or limma-spline only.",
      "Both-method hits have convergent statistical support; method-only hits should be interpreted with that model's assumptions."
    ),
    Method = c(
      "Differential-trajectory method supplying proteins to the Mfuzz run.",
      "Compare rows to see how model selection changes clustering inputs and results."
    ),
    SignificantProteins = c(
      "Number of proteins selected by the indicated trajectory method.",
      "This is the initial input count for that method's independent Mfuzz analysis."
    ),
    ClusteredProfiles = c(
      "Number of complete standardized profiles actually clustered.",
      "A value below SignificantProteins indicates profiles were removed before clustering."
    ),
    TimePoints = c(
      "Number of group-difference time points in each clustered profile.",
      "More time points allow more trajectory detail but can affect fuzzifier estimation."
    ),
    Fuzzifier = c(
      "Mfuzz fuzzification parameter m.",
      "Higher values produce softer, more distributed memberships; compare it alongside membership values."
    ),
    CandidateMinimumClusters = c(
      "Smallest cluster count evaluated.",
      "This is the lower boundary of the Dmin and cselection search, not a result."
    ),
    CandidateMaximumClusters = c(
      "Largest cluster count evaluated.",
      "This is the upper search boundary and may be limited by the number of profiles."
    ),
    DiagnosticRepeats = c(
      "Number of repeated random starts used for cluster diagnostics.",
      "More repeats give a more stable assessment of empty clusters and centroid distance."
    ),
    SelectedClusters = c(
      "Cluster count selected from the diagnostic candidates.",
      "Use it as an exploratory partition of trajectory shapes rather than a tested biological truth."
    ),
    CoreMembershipThreshold = c(
      "Minimum maximum membership used to call a core cluster member.",
      "This is a descriptive cutoff and does not represent a p-value."
    ),
    CoreProteins = c(
      "Number of proteins meeting the core-membership threshold.",
      "A larger fraction suggests crisper assignment to the fitted clusters."
    ),
    MedianMaximumMembership = c(
      "Median, across proteins, of each protein's highest cluster membership.",
      "Values nearer 1 indicate clearer assignments; lower values indicate overlapping trajectories."
    ),
    Backend = c(
      "Software implementation used for fuzzy c-means and diagnostics.",
      "Report it for reproducibility; Mfuzz-compatible fallback results use the same stated parameterization."
    ),
    Cluster = c(
      "Highest-membership Mfuzz cluster assigned to the protein or summary row.",
      "Cluster numbers are arbitrary labels; interpret them from their centroid and effect trajectory."
    ),
    MaximumMembership = c(
      "Largest fuzzy membership value across all clusters for the protein.",
      "Values nearer 1 indicate a clearer assignment to the reported Cluster."
    ),
    Membership = c(
      "Maximum fuzzy membership in the reported method-specific cluster.",
      "Values nearer 1 indicate a clearer cluster assignment; a dash means the protein was not clustered by that method."
    ),
    CoreMember = c(
      "Whether MaximumMembership meets core_membership.",
      "TRUE marks a descriptive core member, not a statistically significant cluster assignment."
    ),
    PeakPositiveTime = c(
      "Time at which the cluster's median comparison-minus-reference effect is largest.",
      "Identifies when the cluster is most shifted toward the comparison group."
    ),
    PeakNegativeTime = c(
      "Time at which the cluster's median comparison-minus-reference effect is smallest.",
      "Identifies when the cluster is most shifted toward the reference group."
    ),
    EarlyMedianEffect = c(
      "Cluster median comparison-minus-reference log2 effect at the earliest time.",
      "Positive values favor the comparison group; negative values favor the reference group."
    ),
    LateMedianEffect = c(
      "Cluster median comparison-minus-reference log2 effect at the latest time.",
      "Compare with EarlyMedianEffect to summarize the direction of trajectory change."
    ),
    TrajectorySummary = c(
      "Observed comparison-minus-reference log2 effect at the earliest and latest time points.",
      "The arrow summarizes endpoint change; inspect the trajectory plot for transient differences between those endpoints."
    ),
    File = c(
      "Machine-readable output filename.",
      "Use the named file for complete results rather than copying only visible HTML rows."
    ),
    Contents = c(
      "Description of the output file's contents.",
      "Use it to choose the appropriate table or saved object for downstream analysis."
    )
  )

  description <- exact[[base_column]]
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("^p\\.valor_", base_column)) {
    term <- sub("^p\\.valor_", "", base_column)
    description <- c(
      paste0("maSigPro term-level p-value for ", term, "."),
      "Use it to see which retained polynomial component supports the fitted model; do not treat basis terms as biological mechanisms."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("^Coefficient_", base_column)) {
    term <- sub("^Coefficient_", "", base_column)
    description <- c(
      paste0("Estimated limma model coefficient for ", term, "."),
      "Its sign depends on the encoded spline basis; rely on the joint interaction test and trajectory plots for biological direction."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("^ModeratedT_", base_column)) {
    term <- sub("^ModeratedT_", "", base_column)
    description <- c(
      paste0("limma empirical-Bayes moderated t statistic for ", term, "."),
      "Magnitude reflects term-level evidence, but the reported limma selection uses the joint moderated F test."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("^MembershipCluster[0-9]+$", base_column)) {
    cluster_number <- sub("^MembershipCluster", "", base_column)
    description <- c(
      paste0("Fuzzy membership in cluster ", cluster_number, "."),
      "Values range from 0 to 1 and sum to 1 across cluster-membership columns for each protein."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("^OrthogonalTime[0-9]+x", base_column)) {
    description <- c(
      "Orthogonal-polynomial group-by-time interaction predictor.",
      "A retained interaction indicates evidence that the comparison trajectory differs from the reference trajectory."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("^OrthogonalTime[0-9]+$", base_column)) {
    description <- c(
      "Orthogonal-polynomial time-basis predictor for the reference group.",
      "It is a mathematical curve component and should not be interpreted alone as a biological phase."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("spline.*spline_basis", base_column)) {
    description <- c(
      "Natural-spline group-by-time interaction predictor.",
      "The interaction columns are tested jointly; individual basis values are not direct biological effects."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("^spline_basis[0-9]+$", base_column)) {
    description <- c(
      "Natural-spline time-basis predictor for the reference group.",
      "It is a mathematical basis value; interpret the fitted trajectory rather than this column alone."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("^spline_group", base_column)) {
    description <- c(
      "Comparison-group main-effect predictor in the limma design.",
      "It represents the encoded baseline group contrast, conditional on the spline parameterization."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && base_column %in% c("X.Intercept.", "(Intercept)")) {
    description <- c(
      "Model intercept predictor.",
      "Represents the encoded reference-group baseline in the fitted design."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description) && grepl("vs", base_column, fixed = TRUE)) {
    description <- c(
      "Comparison-versus-reference group indicator in the maSigPro design.",
      "Encodes the constant group offset before group-by-time interactions are considered."
    )
  }
  if (is.null(description)) {
    description <- c(
      paste0("Analysis field named ", base_column, "."),
      "Interpret this field in the context of the table caption and configured model."
    )
  }
  description[[1]] <- paste0(source_prefix, description[[1]])
  description
}

column_guide <- function(columns, note = NULL) {
  definitions <- t(vapply(
    as.character(columns), describe_timecourse_column, character(2)
  ))
  guide <- tibble(
    Column = as.character(columns),
    Meaning = definitions[, 1],
    `How to interpret` = definitions[, 2]
  )
  cat(
    '\n<details class="column-guide" style="margin:0.75rem 0 1.5rem 0;">',
    '\n<summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;">',
    'Column meanings and interpretation</summary>\n',
    sep = ""
  )
  if (!is.null(note) && nzchar(note)) {
    cat('<p style="margin-top:0.75rem;">', note, '</p>\n', sep = "")
  }
  cat('<div style="overflow-x:auto;">\n')
  cat(as.character(knitr::kable(
    guide, format = "html", escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-sm table-striped"'
  )))
  cat('\n</div>\n</details>\n')
  invisible(guide)
}

format_report_p <- function(values) {
  formatted <- format.pval(values, digits = 3, eps = 1e-99)
  formatted[is.na(values)] <- "—"
  formatted
}

format_report_number <- function(values, digits = 3) {
  formatted <- formatC(values, format = "f", digits = digits)
  formatted[is.na(values)] <- "—"
  formatted
}

format_report_cluster <- function(values) {
  formatted <- as.character(as.integer(values))
  formatted[is.na(values)] <- "—"
  formatted
}

extract_significant_names <- function(significant_object) {
  profiles <- significant_object$sig.profiles
  if (is.null(profiles) || !nrow(profiles)) character() else rownames(profiles)
}

choose_cluster_count <- function(cluster_numbers, minimum_distances, nonempty_matrix) {
  fully_nonempty <- apply(nonempty_matrix, 2, min) == cluster_numbers
  eligible <- which(fully_nonempty)
  if (length(eligible) < 3L) {
    return(cluster_numbers[max(eligible, 1L)])
  }

  x <- cluster_numbers[eligible]
  y <- minimum_distances[eligible]
  x_scaled <- (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
  y_scaled <- (y - min(y)) / (max(y) - min(y))
  straight_line <- 1 - x_scaled
  elbow_score <- straight_line - y_scaled
  x[[which.max(elbow_score)]]
}

estimate_fuzzifier <- function(profile_matrix) {
  proteins <- nrow(profile_matrix)
  time_points <- ncol(profile_matrix)
  1 + (1418 / proteins + 22.05) * time_points^(-2) +
    (12.33 / proteins + 0.243) *
      time_points^(-0.0406 * log(proteins) - 0.1134)
}

fallback_dmin <- function(profile_matrix, fuzzifier, cluster_candidates, repeats) {
  distances <- matrix(
    NA_real_, nrow = length(cluster_candidates), ncol = repeats
  )
  for (repetition in seq_len(repeats)) {
    for (index in seq_along(cluster_candidates)) {
      fit <- e1071::cmeans(
        profile_matrix,
        centers = cluster_candidates[[index]],
        m = fuzzifier,
        iter.max = 1000,
        method = "cmeans",
        dist = "euclidean"
      )
      distances[index, repetition] <- min(stats::dist(fit$centers))
    }
  }
  rowMeans(distances)
}

fallback_cselection <- function(
    profile_matrix, fuzzifier, cluster_candidates, repeats) {
  nonempty <- matrix(
    0L, nrow = repeats, ncol = length(cluster_candidates)
  )
  for (index in seq_along(cluster_candidates)) {
    for (repetition in seq_len(repeats)) {
      fit <- e1071::cmeans(
        profile_matrix,
        centers = cluster_candidates[[index]],
        m = fuzzifier,
        iter.max = 1000,
        method = "cmeans",
        dist = "euclidean"
      )
      nonempty[repetition, index] <- sum(
        colSums(fit$membership > 0.5) > 0
      )
    }
  }
  nonempty
}

fit_method_mfuzz <- function(
    method, selected_proteins, protein_data, time_values, groups, params) {
  condition_summary <- protein_data |>
    filter(
      .data$Protein %in% selected_proteins,
      is.finite(.data$Log2Abundance)
    ) |>
    group_by(.data$Protein, .data$Time, .data$Group) |>
    summarise(
      MeanLog2Abundance = mean(.data$Log2Abundance),
      SDLog2Abundance = stats::sd(.data$Log2Abundance),
      Replicates = n(),
      SELog2Abundance = .data$SDLog2Abundance / sqrt(.data$Replicates),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  effect_long <- condition_summary |>
    select(Protein, Time, Group, MeanLog2Abundance) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = MeanLog2Abundance) |>
    mutate(
      Effect = .data[[params$comparison_group]] -
        .data[[params$reference_group]]
    )

  effect_table <- effect_long |>
    select(Protein, Time, Effect) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = Effect)
  time_columns <- as.character(time_values)
  effect_matrix <- as.matrix(effect_table[, time_columns, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(effect_matrix) <- "double"
  rownames(effect_matrix) <- effect_table$Protein
  if (any(!is.finite(effect_matrix))) {
    stop(
      "Balanced coverage should produce complete condition means for ",
      method, ", but missing effects remain.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  effect_eset <- Biobase::ExpressionSet(
    assayData = effect_matrix,
    phenoData = Biobase::AnnotatedDataFrame(data.frame(
      Time = time_values,
      row.names = time_columns
    ))
  )

  if (mfuzz_package_available) {
    effect_eset <- Mfuzz::filter.NA(effect_eset, thres = 0)
    effect_eset <- Mfuzz::filter.std(effect_eset, min.std = 0, visu = FALSE)
    standardized_eset <- Mfuzz::standardise(effect_eset)
    standardized_matrix <- Biobase::exprs(standardized_eset)
    fuzzifier <- Mfuzz::mestimate(standardized_eset)
    backend <- "Mfuzz"
  } else {
    standardized_matrix <- t(scale(t(effect_matrix)))
    retained <- apply(standardized_matrix, 1, function(values) {
      all(is.finite(values))
    })
    standardized_matrix <- standardized_matrix[retained, , drop = FALSE]
    effect_eset <- effect_eset[retained, ]
    standardized_eset <- Biobase::ExpressionSet(
      assayData = standardized_matrix,
      phenoData = Biobase::phenoData(effect_eset)
    )
    fuzzifier <- estimate_fuzzifier(standardized_matrix)
    backend <- "Mfuzz-compatible e1071 fallback"
  }

  maximum_candidate <- min(
    as.integer(params$max_clusters), nrow(standardized_matrix) - 1L
  )
  cluster_candidates <- seq.int(
    as.integer(params$min_clusters), maximum_candidate
  )
  if (length(cluster_candidates) < 2L) {
    stop(
      method, " has too few selected proteins for the configured Mfuzz range.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  set.seed(as.integer(params$random_seed))
  if (mfuzz_package_available) {
    minimum_centroid_distance <- Mfuzz::Dmin(
      standardized_eset,
      m = fuzzifier,
      crange = cluster_candidates,
      repeats = as.integer(params$cluster_diagnostic_repeats),
      visu = FALSE
    )
    set.seed(as.integer(params$random_seed))
    nonempty_clusters <- Mfuzz::cselection(
      standardized_eset,
      m = fuzzifier,
      crange = cluster_candidates,
      repeats = as.integer(params$cluster_diagnostic_repeats),
      visu = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    minimum_centroid_distance <- fallback_dmin(
      standardized_matrix, fuzzifier, cluster_candidates,
      as.integer(params$cluster_diagnostic_repeats)
    )
    set.seed(as.integer(params$random_seed))
    nonempty_clusters <- fallback_cselection(
      standardized_matrix, fuzzifier, cluster_candidates,
      as.integer(params$cluster_diagnostic_repeats)
    )
  }

  chosen_clusters <- choose_cluster_count(
    cluster_candidates, minimum_centroid_distance, nonempty_clusters
  )
  set.seed(as.integer(params$random_seed))
  if (mfuzz_package_available) {
    fit <- Mfuzz::mfuzz(
      standardized_eset,
      centers = chosen_clusters,
      m = fuzzifier,
      iter.max = 1000
    )
  } else {
    fit <- e1071::cmeans(
      standardized_matrix,
      centers = chosen_clusters,
      m = fuzzifier,
      iter.max = 1000,
      method = "cmeans",
      dist = "euclidean"
    )
  }

  membership_table <- as.data.frame(fit$membership) |>
    rownames_to_column("Protein")
  names(membership_table)[-1] <- paste0(
    "MembershipCluster", seq_len(chosen_clusters)
  )
  membership_matrix <- as.matrix(membership_table[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  assignments <- membership_table |>
    mutate(
      Cluster = as.integer(fit$cluster),
      MaximumMembership = apply(membership_matrix, 1, max),
      CoreMember = .data$MaximumMembership >= params$core_membership
    ) |>
    relocate(Protein, Cluster, MaximumMembership, CoreMember)

  centroid_table <- as.data.frame(fit$centers) |>
    rownames_to_column("Cluster") |>
    mutate(Cluster = as.integer(.data$Cluster))
  names(centroid_table)[-1] <- paste0("Time", time_values)

  diagnostics <- tibble(
    CandidateClusters = cluster_candidates,
    MinimumCentroidDistance = minimum_centroid_distance,
    MedianNonemptyClusters = apply(nonempty_clusters, 2, stats::median),
    MinimumNonemptyClusters = apply(nonempty_clusters, 2, min),
    MaximumNonemptyClusters = apply(nonempty_clusters, 2, max),
    Selected = cluster_candidates == chosen_clusters
  )

  cluster_summary <- assignments |>
    group_by(.data$Cluster) |>
    summarise(
      Proteins = n(),
      CoreProteins = sum(.data$CoreMember),
      MedianMaximumMembership = stats::median(.data$MaximumMembership),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    left_join(
      effect_long |>
        inner_join(assignments |> select(Protein, Cluster), by = "Protein") |>
        group_by(.data$Cluster, .data$Time) |>
        summarise(
          MedianEffect = stats::median(.data$Effect), .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        group_by(.data$Cluster) |>
        summarise(
          PeakPositiveTime = .data$Time[which.max(.data$MedianEffect)],
          PeakNegativeTime = .data$Time[which.min(.data$MedianEffect)],
          EarlyMedianEffect = .data$MedianEffect[which.min(.data$Time)],
          LateMedianEffect = .data$MedianEffect[which.max(.data$Time)],
          .groups = "drop"
        ),
      by = "Cluster"
    )

  parameters <- tibble(
    Method = method,
    SignificantProteins = length(selected_proteins),
    ClusteredProfiles = nrow(standardized_matrix),
    TimePoints = ncol(standardized_matrix),
    Fuzzifier = fuzzifier,
    CandidateMinimumClusters = min(cluster_candidates),
    CandidateMaximumClusters = max(cluster_candidates),
    DiagnosticRepeats = as.integer(params$cluster_diagnostic_repeats),
    SelectedClusters = chosen_clusters,
    CoreMembershipThreshold = as.numeric(params$core_membership),
    CoreProteins = sum(assignments$CoreMember),
    MedianMaximumMembership = median(assignments$MaximumMembership),
    Backend = backend
  )

  list(
    method = method,
    condition_summary = condition_summary,
    effect_long = effect_long,
    effect_expression_set = effect_eset,
    standardized_expression_set = standardized_eset,
    fuzzifier = fuzzifier,
    cluster_candidates = cluster_candidates,
    selected_clusters = chosen_clusters,
    fit = fit,
    assignments = assignments,
    centroids = centroid_table,
    diagnostics = diagnostics,
    cluster_summary = cluster_summary,
    parameters = parameters
  )
}
```

```{r prepare-data, include=FALSE}
analysis_objects <- readRDS(analysis_file)
required_objects <- c("protein_level_data", "annotation", "analysis_settings")
missing_objects <- setdiff(required_objects, names(analysis_objects))
if (length(missing_objects)) {
  stop(
    "The analysis RDS is missing: ", paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

annotation_source <- as_tibble(analysis_objects$annotation)
required_annotation_columns <- c(
  "Run", "BioReplicate", params$time_column, params$group_column
)
missing_annotation_columns <- setdiff(
  required_annotation_columns, names(annotation_source)
)
if (length(missing_annotation_columns)) {
  stop(
    "The saved annotation is missing: ",
    paste(missing_annotation_columns, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

groups <- c(params$reference_group, params$comparison_group)
annotation <- annotation_source |>
  transmute(
    Run = as.character(.data$Run),
    Time = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[params$time_column]])),
    Group = as.character(.data[[params$group_column]]),
    BioReplicate = as.character(.data$BioReplicate)
  ) |>
  filter(.data$Group %in% groups) |>
  mutate(Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = groups)) |>
  arrange(.data$Time, .data$Group, .data$BioReplicate) |>
  group_by(.data$Time, .data$Group) |>
  mutate(Replicate = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

if (any(!is.finite(annotation$Time))) {
  stop("The time column must contain numeric values.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (anyDuplicated(annotation$Run)) {
  stop("Each run must occur exactly once in the saved annotation.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (anyDuplicated(annotation$BioReplicate)) {
  stop(
    "This report is configured for independent samples, but BioReplicate identifiers repeat.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
if (!setequal(as.character(unique(annotation$Group)), groups)) {
  stop("Both configured groups must be present in the annotation.", call. = FALSE)
}

cell_sizes <- annotation |>
  count(.data$Time, .data$Group, name = "AvailableReplicates")
if (any(cell_sizes$AvailableReplicates < params$min_replicates_per_cell)) {
  stop(
    "At least one group-time cell has fewer samples than min_replicates_per_cell.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

protein_source <- as_tibble(analysis_objects$protein_level_data)
required_protein_columns <- c("Protein", "originalRUN", "LogIntensities")
missing_protein_columns <- setdiff(required_protein_columns, names(protein_source))
if (length(missing_protein_columns)) {
  stop(
    "The saved protein-level table is missing: ",
    paste(missing_protein_columns, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

protein_data <- protein_source |>
  transmute(
    Protein = as.character(.data$Protein),
    Run = as.character(.data$originalRUN),
    Log2Abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data$LogIntensities))
  ) |>
  inner_join(annotation, by = "Run")

protein_gene_annotation <- tibble(
  Protein = unique(protein_data$Protein),
  GeneSymbol = NA_character_
)
if (!is.null(protein_workbook)) {
  source_protein_annotation <- read_pd_protein_annotation(protein_workbook)
  protein_gene_annotation$GeneSymbol <- match_pd_gene_symbols(
    protein_gene_annotation$Protein,
    source_protein_annotation
  )
}

add_gene_symbols <- function(data) {
  if (!"Protein" %in% names(data)) return(data)
  data |>
    select(-any_of("GeneSymbol")) |>
    left_join(protein_gene_annotation, by = "Protein") |>
    relocate(.data$GeneSymbol, .after = .data$Protein)
}

add_mfuzz_gene_symbols <- function(result) {
  result$condition_summary <- add_gene_symbols(result$condition_summary)
  result$effect_long <- add_gene_symbols(result$effect_long)
  result$assignments <- add_gene_symbols(result$assignments)
  result
}

duplicate_protein_runs <- protein_data |>
  count(.data$Protein, .data$Run, name = "Rows") |>
  filter(.data$Rows > 1L)
if (nrow(duplicate_protein_runs)) {
  stop("Protein/run rows must be unique before time-course modeling.", call. = FALSE)
}

time_values <- sort(unique(annotation$Time))
effect_label <- paste(params$comparison_group, "-", params$reference_group)
interaction_label <- paste0(params$comparison_group, "-by-time")
group_time_cells <- length(time_values) * length(groups)
coverage <- protein_data |>
  filter(is.finite(.data$Log2Abundance)) |>
  count(.data$Protein, .data$Time, .data$Group, name = "MeasuredReplicates") |>
  complete(
    Protein,
    Time = time_values,
    Group = factor(groups, levels = groups),
    fill = list(MeasuredReplicates = 0L)
  )

protein_coverage <- coverage |>
  group_by(.data$Protein) |>
  summarise(
    MinimumCellReplicates = min(.data$MeasuredReplicates),
    TotalMeasurements = sum(.data$MeasuredReplicates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

coverage_proteins <- protein_coverage |>
  filter(.data$MinimumCellReplicates >= params$min_replicates_per_cell) |>
  pull(.data$Protein)

sample_order <- annotation$Run
expression_table <- protein_data |>
  filter(.data$Protein %in% coverage_proteins) |>
  select(.data$Protein, .data$Run, .data$Log2Abundance) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .data$Run, values_from = .data$Log2Abundance)

expression_matrix <- as.matrix(expression_table[, sample_order, drop = FALSE])
storage.mode(expression_matrix) <- "double"
rownames(expression_matrix) <- expression_table$Protein
protein_sd <- apply(expression_matrix, 1, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)
variable_proteins <- is.finite(protein_sd) & protein_sd > 0
expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[variable_proteins, , drop = FALSE]

minimum_observations <- params$min_replicates_per_cell *
  length(time_values) * length(groups)

filter_summary <- tibble(
  Step = c(
    "Proteins in saved MSstats protein-level data",
    paste0(
      "At least ", params$min_replicates_per_cell,
      " replicates in every group-time cell"
    ),
    "Non-zero variation across samples"
  ),
  Proteins = c(
    n_distinct(protein_data$Protein),
    length(coverage_proteins),
    nrow(expression_matrix)
  )
)
```

```{r run-trajectory-models, include=FALSE}
baseline_time <- min(annotation$Time)
scaled_time <- (annotation$Time - baseline_time) / params$time_unit

experimental_design <- data.frame(
  Time = scaled_time,
  Replicate = annotation$Replicate,
  row.names = annotation$Run,
  check.names = FALSE
)
experimental_design[[params$reference_group]] <- as.integer(
  annotation$Group == params$reference_group
)
experimental_design[[params$comparison_group]] <- as.integer(
  annotation$Group == params$comparison_group
)

orthogonal_time <- stats::poly(
  scaled_time, degree = as.integer(params$polynomial_degree)
)
comparison_indicator <- as.integer(
  annotation$Group == params$comparison_group
)
masigpro_predictors <- matrix(
  comparison_indicator,
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = list(annotation$Run, paste0(
    params$comparison_group, "vs", params$reference_group
  ))
)
masigpro_groups <- paste0(
  params$comparison_group, "vs", params$reference_group
)
for (degree in seq_len(as.integer(params$polynomial_degree))) {
  main_name <- paste0("OrthogonalTime", degree)
  interaction_name <- paste0(main_name, "x", params$comparison_group)
  masigpro_predictors <- cbind(
    masigpro_predictors,
    orthogonal_time[, degree],
    orthogonal_time[, degree] * comparison_indicator
  )
  colnames(masigpro_predictors)[(ncol(masigpro_predictors) - 1):ncol(masigpro_predictors)] <-
    c(main_name, interaction_name)
  masigpro_groups <- c(
    masigpro_groups, params$reference_group,
    paste0(params$comparison_group, "vs", params$reference_group)
  )
}
masigpro_design <- list(
  dis = as.data.frame(masigpro_predictors, check.names = FALSE),
  groups.vector = masigpro_groups,
  edesign = experimental_design
)

masigpro_console <- capture.output(
  masigpro_fit <- maSigPro::p.vector(
    expression_matrix,
    masigpro_design,
    Q = params$model_fdr,
    MT.adjust = "BH",
    min.obs = minimum_observations,
    counts = FALSE
  )
)

tfit_console <- capture.output(
  masigpro_tfit <- maSigPro::T.fit(
    masigpro_fit,
    step.method = "backward",
    alfa = params$coefficient_alpha
  )
)

masigpro_significant_all <- maSigPro::get.siggenes(
  masigpro_tfit,
  rsq = params$min_r_squared,
  vars = "all"
)
masigpro_significant_each <- maSigPro::get.siggenes(
  masigpro_tfit,
  rsq = params$min_r_squared,
  vars = "each"
)
masigpro_significant_groups <- maSigPro::get.siggenes(
  masigpro_tfit,
  rsq = params$min_r_squared,
  vars = "groups"
)

masigpro_variable_significance <- bind_rows(lapply(
  names(masigpro_significant_each$sig.genes),
  function(variable) {
    tibble(
      Variable = variable,
      Protein = extract_significant_names(
        masigpro_significant_each$sig.genes[[variable]]
      )
    )
  }
))

masigpro_variable_counts <- masigpro_variable_significance |>
  dplyr::count(.data$Variable, name = "Proteins") |>
  complete(
    Variable = names(masigpro_significant_each$sig.genes),
    fill = list(Proteins = 0L)
  )

masigpro_interaction_variables <- names(masigpro_significant_each$sig.genes)[
  grepl(
    paste0("x", params$comparison_group),
    names(masigpro_significant_each$sig.genes),
    fixed = TRUE
  )
]
masigpro_differential_proteins <- masigpro_variable_significance |>
  filter(.data$Variable %in% masigpro_interaction_variables) |>
  distinct(.data$Protein) |>
  pull(.data$Protein)

if (!length(masigpro_differential_proteins)) {
  stop(
    "No proteins passed the orthogonal maSigPro time-by-group criteria; Mfuzz cannot proceed.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

masigpro_overall_results <- tibble(
  Protein = rownames(masigpro_fit$p.vector),
  OverallModelPValue = as.numeric(masigpro_fit$p.vector[, 1]),
  OverallModelAdjustedPValue = as.numeric(masigpro_fit$p.adjusted)
)

masigpro_selected_models <- as.data.frame(
  masigpro_tfit$sol,
  check.names = FALSE
) |>
  rownames_to_column("Protein")
names(masigpro_selected_models)[2:3] <- c(
  "StepwiseModelPValue", "ModelRSquared"
)

masigpro_results <- masigpro_overall_results |>
  left_join(masigpro_selected_models, by = "Protein") |>
  mutate(
    PassedOverallModelFDR = .data$OverallModelAdjustedPValue <= params$model_fdr,
    PassedRSquared = !is.na(.data$ModelRSquared) &
      .data$ModelRSquared >= params$min_r_squared,
    DifferentialTimeInteraction = .data$Protein %in%
      masigpro_differential_proteins
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(.data$DifferentialTimeInteraction),
    .data$OverallModelAdjustedPValue,
    desc(.data$ModelRSquared)
  )

masigpro_group_counts <- tibble(
  GroupComponent = names(masigpro_significant_groups$sig.genes),
  Proteins = vapply(
    masigpro_significant_groups$sig.genes,
    function(x) length(extract_significant_names(x)),
    integer(1)
  )
)

spline_basis <- splines::ns(
  scaled_time, df = as.integer(params$spline_df)
)
spline_group <- factor(
  annotation$Group,
  levels = c(params$reference_group, params$comparison_group)
)
limma_design <- model.matrix(~ spline_group * spline_basis)
colnames(limma_design) <- make.names(colnames(limma_design))
colnames(limma_design)[[1]] <- "Intercept"
rownames(limma_design) <- annotation$Run
limma_fit <- limma::eBayes(limma::lmFit(expression_matrix, limma_design))
limma_interaction_columns <- grep(
  "spline_group.*spline_basis|spline_basis.*spline_group",
  colnames(limma_design)
)
limma_interaction_results <- limma::topTable(
  limma_fit,
  coef = limma_interaction_columns,
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "none"
) |>
  rownames_to_column("Protein") |>
  select(
    Protein,
    InteractionF = F,
    InteractionPValue = P.Value,
    InteractionAdjustedPValue = adj.P.Val
  )
limma_coefficients <- as.data.frame(limma_fit$coefficients) |>
  rownames_to_column("Protein")
names(limma_coefficients)[-1] <- paste0(
  "Coefficient_", names(limma_coefficients)[-1]
)
limma_t_statistics <- as.data.frame(
  limma_fit$t[, limma_interaction_columns, drop = FALSE]
) |>
  rownames_to_column("Protein")
names(limma_t_statistics)[-1] <- paste0(
  "ModeratedT_", colnames(limma_design)[limma_interaction_columns]
)
limma_fitted <- limma_fit$coefficients %*% t(limma_design)
limma_r_squared <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(expression_matrix)), function(index) {
  observed <- is.finite(expression_matrix[index, ])
  values <- expression_matrix[index, observed]
  fitted <- limma_fitted[index, observed]
  total <- sum((values - mean(values))^2)
  if (total > 0) 1 - sum((values - fitted)^2) / total else NA_real_
}, numeric(1))
limma_results <- limma_interaction_results |>
  left_join(limma_coefficients, by = "Protein") |>
  left_join(limma_t_statistics, by = "Protein") |>
  mutate(
    FullModelRSquared = limma_r_squared[match(.data$Protein, rownames(expression_matrix))],
    DifferentialTimeInteraction =
      .data$InteractionAdjustedPValue <= params$limma_interaction_fdr
  ) |>
  arrange(.data$InteractionAdjustedPValue)
limma_differential_proteins <- limma_results |>
  filter(.data$DifferentialTimeInteraction) |>
  pull(.data$Protein)
if (!length(limma_differential_proteins)) {
  stop(
    "No proteins passed the limma-spline interaction FDR; Mfuzz cannot proceed.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

combined_significant_results <- full_join(
  masigpro_results |>
    rename_with(~ paste0("maSigPro_", .x), -Protein),
  limma_results |>
    rename_with(~ paste0("limmaSpline_", .x), -Protein),
  by = "Protein"
) |>
  mutate(
    SignificantInMaSigPro = .data$Protein %in% masigpro_differential_proteins,
    SignificantInLimmaSpline = .data$Protein %in% limma_differential_proteins,
    SignificanceCategory = case_when(
      .data$SignificantInMaSigPro & .data$SignificantInLimmaSpline ~
        "Both methods",
      .data$SignificantInMaSigPro ~ "maSigPro only",
      .data$SignificantInLimmaSpline ~ "limma-spline only",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(.data$SignificanceCategory != "Not significant") |>
  arrange(
    factor(
      .data$SignificanceCategory,
      levels = c("Both methods", "maSigPro only", "limma-spline only")
    ),
    .data$maSigPro_OverallModelAdjustedPValue,
    .data$limmaSpline_InteractionAdjustedPValue
  )

method_overlap_summary <- combined_significant_results |>
  dplyr::count(.data$SignificanceCategory, name = "Proteins") |>
  complete(
    SignificanceCategory = c(
      "Both methods", "maSigPro only", "limma-spline only"
    ),
    fill = list(Proteins = 0L)
  )
```

```{r run-method-specific-mfuzz, include=FALSE}
masigpro_mfuzz <- fit_method_mfuzz(
  "Orthogonal maSigPro",
  masigpro_differential_proteins,
  protein_data,
  time_values,
  groups,
  params
)
limma_mfuzz <- fit_method_mfuzz(
  "limma-spline",
  limma_differential_proteins,
  protein_data,
  time_values,
  groups,
  params
)
mfuzz_parameter_comparison <- bind_rows(
  masigpro_mfuzz$parameters,
  limma_mfuzz$parameters
)

# Gene symbols are descriptive annotations and are joined only after all
# statistical modeling and clustering are complete.
protein_coverage <- add_gene_symbols(protein_coverage)
masigpro_variable_significance <- add_gene_symbols(
  masigpro_variable_significance
)
masigpro_results <- add_gene_symbols(masigpro_results)
limma_results <- add_gene_symbols(limma_results)
combined_significant_results <- add_gene_symbols(
  combined_significant_results
)
masigpro_mfuzz <- add_mfuzz_gene_symbols(masigpro_mfuzz)
limma_mfuzz <- add_mfuzz_gene_symbols(limma_mfuzz)

union_trajectory_summary <- protein_data |>
  filter(.data$Protein %in% combined_significant_results$Protein) |>
  group_by(.data$Protein, .data$Time, .data$Group) |>
  summarise(
    MeanLog2Abundance = mean(.data$Log2Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .data$Group, values_from = .data$MeanLog2Abundance) |>
  mutate(
    Effect = .data[[params$comparison_group]] -
      .data[[params$reference_group]]
  ) |>
  arrange(.data$Protein, .data$Time) |>
  group_by(.data$Protein) |>
  summarise(
    EarlyEffect = first(.data$Effect),
    LateEffect = last(.data$Effect),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    TrajectorySummary = paste0(
      params$comparison_group, " − ", params$reference_group, ": ",
      sprintf("%+.2f", .data$EarlyEffect), " → ",
      sprintf("%+.2f", .data$LateEffect), " log2"
    )
  )

combined_interpretation_results <- combined_significant_results |>
  transmute(
    Protein = .data$Protein,
    GeneSymbol = .data$GeneSymbol,
    SignificanceCategory = .data$SignificanceCategory,
    maSigPro_AdjPValue = .data$maSigPro_OverallModelAdjustedPValue,
    maSigPro_RSquared = .data$maSigPro_ModelRSquared,
    limma_AdjPValue = .data$limmaSpline_InteractionAdjustedPValue
  ) |>
  left_join(
    masigpro_mfuzz$assignments |>
      transmute(
        Protein = .data$Protein,
        maSigPro_Cluster = .data$Cluster,
        maSigPro_Membership = .data$MaximumMembership
      ),
    by = "Protein"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    limma_mfuzz$assignments |>
      transmute(
        Protein = .data$Protein,
        limma_Cluster = .data$Cluster,
        limma_Membership = .data$MaximumMembership
      ),
    by = "Protein"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    union_trajectory_summary |>
      select(.data$Protein, .data$TrajectorySummary),
    by = "Protein"
  )

# Backward-compatible report aliases point to the orthogonal-maSigPro branch.
significant_all <- masigpro_significant_all
significant_each <- masigpro_significant_each
significant_groups <- masigpro_significant_groups
variable_significance <- masigpro_variable_significance
variable_counts <- masigpro_variable_counts
interaction_variables <- masigpro_interaction_variables
differential_time_proteins <- masigpro_differential_proteins
group_counts <- masigpro_group_counts
condition_summary <- masigpro_mfuzz$condition_summary
effect_long <- masigpro_mfuzz$effect_long
effect_eset <- masigpro_mfuzz$effect_expression_set
standardized_eset <- masigpro_mfuzz$standardized_expression_set
fuzzifier <- masigpro_mfuzz$fuzzifier
cluster_candidates <- masigpro_mfuzz$cluster_candidates
chosen_clusters <- masigpro_mfuzz$selected_clusters
mfuzz_fit <- masigpro_mfuzz$fit
cluster_assignments <- masigpro_mfuzz$assignments
centroid_table <- masigpro_mfuzz$centroids
cluster_diagnostics <- masigpro_mfuzz$diagnostics
cluster_summary <- masigpro_mfuzz$cluster_summary
```

```{r save-results, include=FALSE}
filter_file <- write_result(protein_coverage, "timecourse_protein_coverage.csv")
masigpro_design_file <- write_result(

# Analysis overview

This report analyzes **`r params$report_label`** using the normalized
protein-level log2 abundances saved by the preceding MSstats report.

The design contains `r nrow(annotation)` independent samples, `r length(time_values)`
time points (`r paste(time_values, collapse = ", ")` hours), and two groups:
`r params$reference_group` and `r params$comparison_group`. Each group-time
cell contains `r paste(sort(unique(cell_sizes$AvailableReplicates)), collapse = ", ")`
biological replicates.

The report uses two complementary differential-trajectory models and then
clusters each model's selected proteins separately:

- **Orthogonal-polynomial maSigPro** uses backward term selection plus the
  configured full-model FDR and minimum $R^2$.
- **limma natural splines** jointly test all group-by-time spline terms with an
  empirical-Bayes moderated F test.
- **Mfuzz** is run independently on each significant-protein set so that their
  trajectory clusters, fuzzifiers, memberships, and selected cluster counts
  can be compared without mixing model inputs.

# Detailed methods

## Source values and experimental unit

The input is `r basename(analysis_file)`, created by the MSstats report. The
`ProteinLevelData` values had already been log2 transformed, normalized by
`r analysis_objects$analysis_settings$normalization`, summarized with
`r analysis_objects$analysis_settings$summary_method`, and processed with
MSstats model-based imputation set to
`r analysis_objects$analysis_settings$model_based_imputation`.

No PSM-level values were reprocessed here. A row represents one protein in one
run. `BioReplicate` identifiers are unique across all runs, so samples are
independent rather than repeated measurements of the same subject.

## Coverage filtering

Time-course models can be driven by uneven missingness if a protein is abundant
in only one group or one part of the experiment. A protein was therefore
required to have a finite MSstats protein abundance in at least
`r params$min_replicates_per_cell` biological replicates in **every** one of the
`r group_time_cells` group-time cells. This per-cell coverage rule is stricter
than an overall missing-value threshold. Proteins with zero variance across all
samples were also removed.

No additional sample-level values were imputed. Both models used the observed
finite values; maSigPro required at least `r minimum_observations` observations
per protein.

## maSigPro regression

[maSigPro](https://bioconductor.org/packages/maSigPro) is a regression-based
method for detecting significant time-course profiles and differences among
experimental groups. The input was the filtered, normalized log2 protein matrix
with proteins in rows and independent samples in columns.

Time was expressed as

$$
t = \frac{\text{hour} - `r baseline_time`}{`r params$time_unit`},
$$

so the intercept corresponds to `r baseline_time` hours and one time unit is
`r params$time_unit` hours. Scaling improves numerical stability without
changing the fitted curves.

A degree-`r params$polynomial_degree` **orthogonal** polynomial basis from
`poly(t, degree)` was used. With `r length(time_values)` time points, this model
can represent broad monotonic and
curved responses without fitting a separate parameter for every time point.
With `r params$reference_group` as the reference, the model is conceptually

$$
y = \beta_0 + \beta_G G +
\sum_{k=1}^{`r params$polynomial_degree`} \beta_k P_k(t) +
\sum_{k=1}^{`r params$polynomial_degree`} \gamma_k(GP_k(t)) + \epsilon,
$$

where $P_k(t)$ are mutually orthogonal polynomial basis columns and $G=1$
for `r params$comparison_group` and 0 for `r params$reference_group`. The
$\gamma_k$ interaction terms test whether the
`r params$comparison_group` trajectory differs from `r params$reference_group`
over time.

`p.vector()` first compared the full model with an intercept-only model using a
Gaussian F test. P-values were adjusted across proteins with Benjamini-Hochberg
and the FDR threshold was `r params$model_fdr`. `T.fit()` then used backward
variable selection with coefficient threshold `r params$coefficient_alpha`.
`get.siggenes()` retained models with $R^2 \ge `r params$min_r_squared`$.

The set passed to Mfuzz was deliberately narrower than the overall maSigPro
set: a protein had to be selected for at least one `r interaction_label`
interaction (`r paste(interaction_variables, collapse = ", ")`). A significant
constant group offset without a time interaction was not considered
differential progression.

## limma natural-spline regression

[limma](https://bioconductor.org/packages/limma) fitted a natural-spline model
with `r params$spline_df` time degrees of freedom:

$$
y_{pi} = \beta_{0p} + \beta_{Gp} G_i +
\sum_{k=1}^{`r params$spline_df`} \beta_{kp} B_k(t_i) +
\sum_{k=1}^{`r params$spline_df`} \gamma_{kp} G_i B_k(t_i) + \epsilon_{pi}.
$$

Here $y_{pi}$ is the normalized log2 abundance of protein $p$ in sample $i$,
$t_i$ is its collection time, and $B_k(t_i)$ are the natural-spline basis
functions. $G_i=1$ for `r params$comparison_group` and 0 for
`r params$reference_group`. The $\beta_{kp}$ coefficients describe the reference
group's time trajectory; $\beta_{Gp}$ describes a constant group offset; and
the $\gamma_{kp}$ coefficients describe the time-dependent difference between
the groups. The residual $\epsilon_{pi}$ represents variation around the
fitted trajectory. limma moderates the protein-specific residual variances
using empirical Bayes estimation.

The joint interaction test asks whether all group-by-spline coefficients are
zero:

$$
H_0: \gamma_{1p} = \cdots = \gamma_{`r params$spline_df`p} = 0.
$$

All group-by-spline coefficients were tested jointly with limma's moderated F
statistic. Interaction p-values were adjusted across proteins with
Benjamini-Hochberg, and proteins with adjusted p-value <=
`r params$limma_interaction_fdr` were selected. The combined result table
exports the joint F statistic, raw and adjusted interaction p-values, full-model
$R^2$, every spline coefficient, and the moderated interaction t statistics.

## How to interpret agreement between the models

Both maSigPro and limma-spline test the same biological question — whether a
protein's trajectory differs between groups — but they differ in how strict the
test is. maSigPro sets a lower bar: a protein is flagged if *any one* of its
polynomial pieces (linear, bend, or S-shape) shows a significant group
difference, even if the rest of the curve looks identical between groups.
limma-spline instead requires the *combined* evidence across all the trajectory
pieces to clear the bar together, so it's better at confidently identifying
features with a differential trajectory across most or all of the time course,
but less likely to flag a feature whose difference shows up briefly at just one
point in time.

Because of this, maSigPro can pick up features with only a localized, transient
trajectory difference that limma-spline might miss. In terms of digesting the
results: features flagged by both methods carry more confidence and should
visually show clean, consistent separation between groups across the time
course. Features flagged by maSigPro alone may still be biologically real, but
should be treated more cautiously — with only
`r min(cell_sizes$AvailableReplicates)` replicates per group-time cell, each
protein's noise estimate is itself imprecise, and a protein that happens to look
artificially "quiet" by chance can produce an inflated significance for
whichever single polynomial term picks up the wiggle. limma's variance
moderation is built to guard against exactly this, which is part of why it
doesn't flag these proteins — so maSigPro-only hits are worth inspecting in the
raw replicate plots, and ideally corroborating before drawing strong
conclusions, rather than being dismissed outright.

## Mfuzz soft clustering

[Mfuzz](https://bioconductor.org/packages/Mfuzz) uses fuzzy c-means clustering.
The package documentation recommends averaging replicates before clustering;
therefore, observed log2 abundances were averaged within each group-time cell.
For every significant protein from each method, the clustering profile was

$$
\Delta_t = \overline{y}_{\text{comparison},t} -
           \overline{y}_{\text{reference},t}
$$

at the `r length(time_values)` time points. Thus, the clusters describe the
*shape of the `r effect_label` effect over time*, not merely abundance over time
in either group.

The balanced coverage filter guaranteed complete group means, so `fill.NA()`
was not used. `filter.NA(thres = 0)` and `filter.std(min.std = 0)` were retained
as safeguards. `standardise()` transformed each effect profile to mean zero and
standard deviation one because Mfuzz uses Euclidean distance. Standardization
affects cluster shape but not the log2-effect values reported in the tables.

The fuzzifier and cluster-number diagnostics were estimated independently for
the maSigPro and limma-spline input sets. Candidate cluster counts from
`r params$min_clusters` through at most `r params$max_clusters` were evaluated
with Dmin and cselection using `r params$cluster_diagnostic_repeats` repeated
starts. Counts that ever produced an empty cluster were excluded. Among the
remaining counts, the selected value was the elbow with the largest distance
below the straight line joining the first and last minimum-centroid-distance
values. Final clustering used a fixed seed and up to 1,000 iterations.

Proteins were assigned to their highest-membership cluster for summaries, but
all membership values are exported. A core member has maximum membership at
least `r params$core_membership`; this threshold is descriptive rather than a
significance test.

## Interpretation limits

- maSigPro assumes independent residuals here; it is not a repeated-measures
  model.
- Orthogonal polynomial and spline basis coefficients are mathematical
  components and should not be interpreted individually as mechanistic kinetic
  effects.
- The source values include MSstats feature-level model-based imputation. The
  per-cell coverage filter reduces, but does not eliminate, dependence on that
  earlier processing.
- Backward variable selection is basis-dependent. limma's joint moderated test
  is a complementary analysis, not a drop-in reproduction of maSigPro.
- Mfuzz clusters and memberships are exploratory. Cluster membership does not
  supply a p-value or prove a biological pathway.

# Orthogonal maSigPro results

The overall model identified **`r masigpro_fit$i` proteins** at BH-adjusted
FDR `r params$model_fdr`. After backward variable selection and the
$R^2$ threshold, **`r significant_all$sig.genes$g` proteins** retained an
adequate fitted trajectory. At least one `r interaction_label` interaction was selected
for **`r length(differential_time_proteins)` proteins**; these were carried into
Mfuzz.

protein_data |>

  standardized_profiles,
  aes(
    x = .data$Time,
    y = .data$StandardizedEffect,
    group = .data$Protein,
    color = .data$MaximumMembership
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_line(
    data = centroid_long,
    aes(
      x = .data$Time,
      y = .data$StandardizedEffect,
      group = .data$Cluster
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = centroid_long,
    aes(
      x = .data$Time,
      y = .data$StandardizedEffect,
      group = .data$Cluster
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cluster, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#D9EAF7", high = "#C44E52") +
  labs(
    x = "Time (hours)",
    y = paste("Standardized", effect_label, "effect"),
    color = "Membership",
    title = "Mfuzz differential-effect profiles"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r mfuzz-effects-log2, fig.height=9, fig.cap="Median comparison-minus-reference log2 effects and interquartile ranges within each assigned cluster. These are unstandardized effect sizes."}

# Combined significant-protein results

The combined table contains the union of both significant-protein sets. It
includes each model's test statistics, adjusted p-values, model fit, fitted
coefficients, selection indicators, and a single `SignificanceCategory` column
that records **Both methods**, **maSigPro only**, or **limma-spline only**.

# Interactive significant-protein trajectory explorer

Search and select any protein identified by either trajectory method. The
dashboard updates entirely in the browser; no data are sent to a server. Raw
points are independent biological replicates, solid lines connect group-time
means, and vertical bars show one standard error above and below each mean.

```{r prepare-trajectory-explorer, include=FALSE}
explorer_time_spacing <- if (length(time_values) > 1L) {
  min(diff(time_values))
} else {
  1
}
explorer_group_offsets <- setNames(
  seq(-0.06, 0.06, length.out = length(groups)) * explorer_time_spacing,
  groups
)

trajectory_explorer_points <- protein_data |>
  filter(
    .data$Protein %in% combined_interpretation_results$Protein,
    is.finite(.data$Log2Abundance)
  ) |>
  transmute(
    Protein = as.character(.data$Protein),
    Run = as.character(.data$Run),
    BioReplicate = as.character(.data$BioReplicate),
    Time = as.numeric(.data$Time),
    Group = as.character(.data$Group),
    Log2Abundance = as.numeric(.data$Log2Abundance)
  ) |>
  arrange(.data$Protein, .data$Time, .data$Group, .data$BioReplicate) |>
  group_by(.data$Protein, .data$Time, .data$Group) |>
  mutate(
    PointTime = .data$Time +
      unname(explorer_group_offsets[.data$Group]) +
      (row_number() - (n() + 1) / 2) * 0.012 * explorer_time_spacing
  ) |>
  ungroup()

trajectory_explorer_means <- trajectory_explorer_points |>
  group_by(.data$Protein, .data$Time, .data$Group) |>
  summarise(
    MeanLog2Abundance = mean(.data$Log2Abundance),
    SDLog2Abundance = stats::sd(.data$Log2Abundance),
    Replicates = n(),
    SELog2Abundance = .data$SDLog2Abundance / sqrt(.data$Replicates),
    LowerSE = .data$MeanLog2Abundance - .data$SELog2Abundance,
    UpperSE = .data$MeanLog2Abundance + .data$SELog2Abundance,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

trajectory_explorer_metadata <- combined_interpretation_results |>
  transmute(
    Protein = as.character(.data$Protein),
    GeneSymbol = as.character(.data$GeneSymbol),
    SignificanceCategory = as.character(.data$SignificanceCategory),
    maSigPro_AdjPValue = format_report_p(.data$maSigPro_AdjPValue),
    maSigPro_RSquared = format_report_number(.data$maSigPro_RSquared),
    limma_AdjPValue = format_report_p(.data$limma_AdjPValue),
    maSigPro_Cluster = format_report_cluster(.data$maSigPro_Cluster),
    maSigPro_Membership = format_report_number(.data$maSigPro_Membership),
    limma_Cluster = format_report_cluster(.data$limma_Cluster),
    limma_Membership = format_report_number(.data$limma_Membership),
    TrajectorySummary = as.character(.data$TrajectorySummary)
  )

trajectory_explorer_payload <- list(
  points = trajectory_explorer_points,
  means = trajectory_explorer_means,
  metadata = trajectory_explorer_metadata,
  groups = as.character(groups),
  times = as.numeric(time_values)
)

trajectory_explorer_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  trajectory_explorer_payload,
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  digits = 10
)
# Prevent a value containing a literal closing script tag from terminating the
# inert JSON element. The data are parsed locally by the classic script below.
trajectory_explorer_json <- gsub(
  "</",
  "<\\/",
  trajectory_explorer_json,
  fixed = TRUE
)
```

    <div class="trajectory-plot-note">Replicate points are slightly offset horizontally to reduce overlap. Lines show group means; vertical bars show ±1 standard error. Hover over a point for its details.</div>

<noscript><p class="trajectory-dashboard-error">Enable JavaScript to use the interactive trajectory explorer.</p></noscript>

<script id="trajectory-dashboard-script">
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const dashboard = document.getElementById("trajectory-explorer-dashboard");
  const errorBox = document.getElementById("trajectory-dashboard-error");

  try {
    const payloadElement = document.getElementById("trajectory-explorer-data");
    const data = JSON.parse(payloadElement.textContent);
    const search = document.getElementById("trajectory-protein-search");
    const select = document.getElementById("trajectory-protein-select");
    const matchCount = document.getElementById("trajectory-match-count");
    const cards = document.getElementById("trajectory-result-cards");
    const chart = document.getElementById("trajectory-chart");
    const plotTitle = document.getElementById("trajectory-plot-title");
    const legend = document.getElementById("trajectory-legend");
    const palette = ["#4C72B0", "#C44E52", "#55A868", "#8172B2", "#CCB974", "#64B5CD"];
    const metadataByProtein = new Map(data.metadata.map(row => [row.Protein, row]));
    const proteins = data.metadata.map(row => row.Protein).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    const pointsByProtein = groupByProtein(data.points);
    const meansByProtein = groupByProtein(data.means);

    function groupByProtein(rows) {
      const grouped = new Map();
      rows.forEach(row => {
        if (!grouped.has(row.Protein)) grouped.set(row.Protein, []);
        grouped.get(row.Protein).push(row);
      });
      return grouped;
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value == null ? "NA" : value)
        .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
        .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
        .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
        .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
        .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
    }

    function displayValue(value) {
      return value == null || value === "" ? "NA" : value;
    }

    function updateOptions() {
      const query = search.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
      const current = select.value;
      const matches = query
        ? proteins.filter(protein => protein.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query))
        : proteins;

      select.replaceChildren();
      matches.forEach(protein => {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = protein;
        option.textContent = protein;
        select.appendChild(option);
      });
      matchCount.textContent = `${matches.length.toLocaleString()} of ${proteins.length.toLocaleString()} significant proteins`;
      select.disabled = matches.length === 0;

      if (!matches.length) {
        showNoMatch();
        return;
      }
      select.value = matches.includes(current) ? current : matches[0];
      updateDashboard(select.value);
    }

    function showNoMatch() {
      cards.innerHTML = `<div class="trajectory-card trajectory-card--category">
        <div class="trajectory-card-label">Protein search</div>
        <div class="trajectory-card-value">No matching protein</div>
        <div class="trajectory-card-detail">Change the search text to restore matching significant proteins.</div>
      </div>`;
      plotTitle.textContent = "No trajectory selected";
      legend.replaceChildren();
      chart.replaceChildren();
    }

    function updateDashboard(protein) {
      const result = metadataByProtein.get(protein);
      if (!result) {
        showNoMatch();
        return;
      }
      cards.innerHTML = `<div class="trajectory-card trajectory-card--category">
          <div class="trajectory-card-label">Selected protein</div>
          <div class="trajectory-card-value">${escapeHtml(result.Protein)}</div>
          <div class="trajectory-card-detail"><strong>Gene symbol (GN):</strong> ${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.GeneSymbol))}<br><span class="trajectory-badge">${escapeHtml(result.SignificanceCategory)}</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="trajectory-card">
          <div class="trajectory-card-label">Orthogonal maSigPro</div>
          <div class="trajectory-card-value">Adjusted p: ${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.maSigPro_AdjPValue))}</div>
          <div class="trajectory-card-detail">R-squared: ${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.maSigPro_RSquared))}<br>Cluster: ${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.maSigPro_Cluster))}<br>Maximum membership: ${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.maSigPro_Membership))}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="trajectory-card trajectory-card--limma">
          <div class="trajectory-card-label">limma-spline</div>
          <div class="trajectory-card-value">Adjusted p: ${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.limma_AdjPValue))}</div>
          <div class="trajectory-card-detail">Cluster: ${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.limma_Cluster))}<br>Maximum membership: ${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.limma_Membership))}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="trajectory-card trajectory-card--effect">
          <div class="trajectory-card-label">Observed trajectory summary</div>
          <div class="trajectory-card-value">${escapeHtml(displayValue(result.TrajectorySummary))}</div>
          <div class="trajectory-card-detail">Earliest to latest observed comparison-minus-reference log2 effect.</div>
        </div>`;
      plotTitle.textContent = `${protein}: observed protein trajectories`;
      renderLegend();
      renderChart(protein);
    }

    function renderLegend() {
      legend.replaceChildren();
      data.groups.forEach((group, index) => {
        const item = document.createElement("span");
        item.className = "trajectory-legend-item";
        const swatch = document.createElement("span");
        swatch.className = "trajectory-legend-swatch";
        swatch.style.backgroundColor = palette[index % palette.length];
        const label = document.createElement("span");
        label.textContent = group;
        item.append(swatch, label);
        legend.appendChild(item);
      });
    }

    function renderChart(protein) {
      const points = pointsByProtein.get(protein) || [];
      const means = meansByProtein.get(protein) || [];
      chart.replaceChildren();
      if (!points.length) {
        chart.textContent = "No trajectory data are available for this protein.";
        return;
      }

      const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      const width = 1050;
      const height = 520;
      const margin = {top: 22, right: 28, bottom: 62, left: 78};
      const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
      const numeric = value => Number.isFinite(Number(value));
      const xValues = points.map(row => Number(row.PointTime)).filter(Number.isFinite)
        .concat(data.times.map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite));
      const yValues = points.map(row => Number(row.Log2Abundance)).filter(Number.isFinite);
      means.forEach(row => {
        if (numeric(row.LowerSE)) yValues.push(Number(row.LowerSE));
        if (numeric(row.UpperSE)) yValues.push(Number(row.UpperSE));
      });
      let xMin = Math.min(...xValues);
      let xMax = Math.max(...xValues);
      let yMin = Math.min(...yValues);
      let yMax = Math.max(...yValues);
      if (xMin === xMax) { xMin -= 0.5; xMax += 0.5; }
      if (yMin === yMax) { yMin -= 0.5; yMax += 0.5; }
      const xPad = (xMax - xMin) * 0.025;
      const yPad = (yMax - yMin) * 0.08;
      xMin -= xPad;
      xMax += xPad;
      yMin -= yPad;
      yMax += yPad;
      const xScale = value => margin.left + ((Number(value) - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * innerWidth;
      const yScale = value => margin.top + innerHeight - ((Number(value) - yMin) / (yMax - yMin)) * innerHeight;
      const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
      svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
      svg.setAttribute("role", "img");
      svg.setAttribute("aria-label", `Observed protein trajectories for ${protein}`);

      function addElement(name, attributes, parent = svg) {
        const element = document.createElementNS(svgNS, name);
        Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
        parent.appendChild(element);
        return element;
      }

      data.times.forEach(time => {
        const x = xScale(time);
        addElement("line", {x1: x, x2: x, y1: margin.top, y2: margin.top + innerHeight, class: "trajectory-grid"});
        const label = addElement("text", {x: x, y: margin.top + innerHeight + 25, "text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": 12});
        label.textContent = time;
      });

      const yTicks = 6;
      for (let index = 0; index < yTicks; index += 1) {
        const value = yMin + ((yMax - yMin) * index) / (yTicks - 1);
        const y = yScale(value);
        addElement("line", {x1: margin.left, x2: margin.left + innerWidth, y1: y, y2: y, class: "trajectory-grid"});
        const label = addElement("text", {x: margin.left - 10, y: y + 4, "text-anchor": "end", "font-size": 12});
        label.textContent = value.toFixed(yMax - yMin < 3 ? 2 : 1);
      }

      addElement("line", {x1: margin.left, x2: margin.left + innerWidth, y1: margin.top + innerHeight, y2: margin.top + innerHeight, class: "trajectory-axis"});
      addElement("line", {x1: margin.left, x2: margin.left, y1: margin.top, y2: margin.top + innerHeight, class: "trajectory-axis"});
      const xLabel = addElement("text", {x: margin.left + innerWidth / 2, y: height - 14, "text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": 13, "font-weight": 600});
      xLabel.textContent = "Time (hours)";
      const yLabel = addElement("text", {x: 18, y: margin.top + innerHeight / 2, "text-anchor": "middle", "font-size": 13, "font-weight": 600, transform: `rotate(-90 18 ${margin.top + innerHeight / 2})`});
      yLabel.textContent = "MSstats normalized log2 abundance";

      data.groups.forEach((group, groupIndex) => {
        const color = palette[groupIndex % palette.length];
        const groupMeans = means.filter(row => row.Group === group).sort((a, b) => Number(a.Time) - Number(b.Time));
        groupMeans.forEach(row => {
          if (numeric(row.LowerSE) && numeric(row.UpperSE)) {
            addElement("line", {x1: xScale(row.Time), x2: xScale(row.Time), y1: yScale(row.LowerSE), y2: yScale(row.UpperSE), stroke: color, "stroke-width": 1.8, "stroke-opacity": 0.8});
          }
        });
        if (groupMeans.length) {
          const pathData = groupMeans.map((row, index) => `${index ? "L" : "M"}${xScale(row.Time)},${yScale(row.MeanLog2Abundance)}`).join(" ");
          addElement("path", {d: pathData, fill: "none", stroke: color, "stroke-width": 2.8, "stroke-linejoin": "round", "stroke-linecap": "round"});
        }
        points.filter(row => row.Group === group).forEach(row => {
          const dot = addElement("circle", {cx: xScale(row.PointTime), cy: yScale(row.Log2Abundance), r: 4.2, fill: color, "fill-opacity": 0.58, stroke: "white", "stroke-width": 0.7});
          const title = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "title");
          title.textContent = `${row.Protein}\n${row.Group}, ${row.Time} h\nBiological replicate: ${row.BioReplicate}\nRun: ${row.Run}\nlog2 abundance: ${Number(row.Log2Abundance).toFixed(2)}`;
          dot.appendChild(title);
        });
        groupMeans.forEach(row => {
          const dot = addElement("circle", {cx: xScale(row.Time), cy: yScale(row.MeanLog2Abundance), r: 5.2, fill: color, stroke: "white", "stroke-width": 1.1});
          const title = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "title");
          const se = numeric(row.SELog2Abundance) ? Number(row.SELog2Abundance).toFixed(2) : "NA";
          title.textContent = `${row.Group}, ${row.Time} h mean\n${Number(row.MeanLog2Abundance).toFixed(2)} ± ${se} SE\nn = ${row.Replicates}`;
          dot.appendChild(title);
        });
      });

      chart.appendChild(svg);
    }

    search.addEventListener("input", updateOptions);
    select.addEventListener("change", () => updateDashboard(select.value));
    updateOptions();
  } catch (error) {
    dashboard.querySelectorAll(":scope > :not(.trajectory-dashboard-error)").forEach(element => element.hidden = true);
    errorBox.hidden = false;
    errorBox.textContent = `The trajectory dashboard could not be initialized: ${error.message}`;
  }
})();
</script>
```

# Output files

The complete tables are saved separately from the HTML report:

```{r output-files}
tibble(
  File = basename(c(
    filter_file,
    masigpro_design_file,
    limma_design_file,
    masigpro_model_file,
    limma_model_file,
    combined_model_file,
    variable_file,
    masigpro_condition_file,
    limma_condition_file,
    masigpro_effect_file,
    limma_effect_file,
    masigpro_membership_file,
    limma_membership_file,
    masigpro_centroid_file,
    limma_centroid_file,
    masigpro_cluster_summary_file,
    limma_cluster_summary_file,
    masigpro_diagnostic_file,
    limma_diagnostic_file,
    mfuzz_parameter_file,
    file.path(output_dir, "timecourse_masigpro_mfuzz_objects.rds")
  )),
  Contents = c(
    "Coverage statistics for every protein",
    "Orthogonal-polynomial design submitted to maSigPro",
    "Natural-spline design submitted to limma",
    "Overall and stepwise orthogonal-maSigPro model results",
    "Moderated joint-interaction limma-spline model results",
    "Union of significant proteins with both models' parameters and method label",
    "Proteins selected for each maSigPro model term",
    "maSigPro-selected observed group-time means and uncertainty",
    "limma-selected observed group-time means and uncertainty",
    "maSigPro comparison-minus-reference clustering effects",
    "limma-spline comparison-minus-reference clustering effects",
    "maSigPro-set Mfuzz memberships and assigned clusters",
    "limma-set Mfuzz memberships and assigned clusters",
    "maSigPro-set standardized Mfuzz centroids",
    "limma-set standardized Mfuzz centroids",
    "maSigPro-set cluster sizes, core counts, and effects",
    "limma-set cluster sizes, core counts, and effects",
    "maSigPro-set Dmin and non-empty diagnostics",
    "limma-set Dmin and non-empty diagnostics",
    "Side-by-side Mfuzz input, fuzzifier, cluster, and membership parameters",
    "Saved filtering, both models, both Mfuzz runs, and parameters"
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Machine-readable time-course analysis outputs.")
```

```{r output-file-columns, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
column_guide(
  c("File", "Contents"),
  "CSV files contain complete machine-readable tables; the RDS preserves fitted objects and parameters for reproducible downstream work."
)
```
